summary: Full Phase 1 testing of Healthcare Hub. Backend (POST/GET /api/messages) verified via pytest (3/3 pass). Frontend verified via Playwright: hero picker, brand cards, expanders, contact strip, testimonials, about, footer, message form (validation + persistence), and mobile sticky bar all work. No page errors.

issues: Minor: testimonial-dot-2 click did not clearly change text in one automated pass; testimonial-next/prev and other dots work. May be a race condition or the same content displayed at that index during test - not user-blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: Consider adding an index on created_at for /api/messages when volume grows (currently OK).
MessageCreate has no field validation (e.g., min_length); backend accepts empty strings if provided as strings. Frontend enforces required, but API-level validation could be tighter for Phase 2.
CORS allow_origins default to '*' with allow_credentials=True — acceptable for public site, tighten in production.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed messages via POST /api/messages during tests (interim MongoDB store).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 fully verified. Test data with TEST_ prefix exists in Mongo 'messages' collection. Phase 2 (Supabase migration + admin CMS + email) not yet built. Use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env; Shadcn Select requires clicking then clicking [role='option'] with force=True.
